items.statement: Replacing half accumulation with zero-init ordered f32 accumulation is intended policy, not original-source equivalence.
FloatModel supplies total keyed operations/conversions; concrete IEEE/native correspondence, NaN payloads, denormals and rounding are not proved.
Per-cell fold follows allPoints lexicographic order; all backend reorderings are not established.
Literal positive-zero of same format through splat or empty/fill; no nonzero/negative-zero/dynamic initializer claim.
Actual maps, iterators, arity, static formats and bounds are checked locally; structuredRanges geometry is not supplied as an unrelated input assumption.
Local tensor operands are typed and initialized at index64; this is not a proof all enclosing model values satisfy that domain.
operand_domain_nonempty constructs zero operands for arbitrary shapes including zero extents; not a model-run witness.
Complete reference/output equality requires operation-head/arity/region invariance and call locality for the common operation interpretation.
Function-count+1 fuel and common external context; no native recursive divergence, effectful ABI or exception preservation claim.
One operand format; injective widening; only contract-step uses of licensed keys; uniform fusion or no fusion. Actual mixed fusion is not covered.
Authoritative parser, serializer, round-trip and byte binding are trusted/regression-tested; W helper controls do not prove parser fidelity.
Lean kernel and ordinary compiled checker correctness per ledger; fresh audit/build outcomes supplied by F, no W native result.
Upstream lowering, OOT/hardware, linker/runtime and whole-model definedness not established by this MACC boundary.
Host connects fresh actual pairs to proved checks and separately authenticated-by-governance human policy review; raw report does not approve itself.
